name: vibeplus-plugin
description: Reviewed plan-to-PR workflow with Obsidian knowledge reuse and bundled code review guidance.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, review, implement, learn, and open pull requests.

interface.defaultPrompt: Use $vibeplus to plan, review, implement, verify, document reusable knowledge, and open a pull request.
